text: VSIP becomes the seventh investor of Đà Nẵng FTZ

ĐÀ NẴNG - The Việt Nam-Singapore Industrial Park (VSIP) joint-venture company has become the investor for the seventh functional area of the Đà Nẵng Free Trade Zone (FTZ7), with land clearance scheduled for 2025-27 ahead of full operation in 2027-32.
The city's People's Committee said VSIP will develop infrastructure for FTZ7 across an area of 276 ha with an investment of VNĐ3.52 trillion (US$140.8 million).
According to the Đà Nẵng Special Economic Zone Authority (DSEZA), the selection of investors for all seven functional sites of the 1,881 ha Đà Nẵng FTZ has been completed.
Two investors - the Sài Gòn-Đà Nẵng Corporation and Sun Group - have already begun construction on FTZ5 and FTZ2, respectively.
DSEZA said FTZ7 was designed for the development of industrial manufacturing, information technology, digital industries and logistics.
Earlier, VSIP was approved as an investor in the Điện Tiến Industrial Park, south of Đà Nẵng, with an investment of $138.15 million.

VSIP had built Key Industrial Park, VSIP Quảng Ngãi I, in 2013 with an investment of $125.3 million, and it started construction on VSIP Quảng Ngãi II with a capital of VNĐ3.37 trillion ($149.4 million) in 2025.

Meanwhile, FTZ Kita Trung Nam Company-a joint venture between Kita Group and Trung Nam Joint-Stock Corporation-has been named the investor for FTZ6, an International Commercial & Service Gateway backed by VNĐ3.35 trillion (US$134 million) in capital.
Two other local investors - Phương Trang Group and Thanh Bình Phú Mỹ JSC - had been given investment licenses for the FTZ3 and FTZ4.
The Đà Nẵng FTZ, one of the most important projects, is expected to contribute 17.9 per cent to the city's gross regional domestic product (GRDP) and create 127,000 jobs by 2040.
A consortium of Hateco and the Netherlands' APM Terminals is developing the US$1.7 billion Liên Chiểu Container Port.

The city has also been calling for investment along the East-West Economic Corridor connecting Myanmar, Thailand, Laos, and Việt Nam, as well as in the Chu Lai seaport and airport system, the Chu Lai Open Economic Zone, and a cluster of key industrial zones in Chu Lai. -VNS
